  "repair_strategy": "Change the line that removes the maxlength attribute to target the textarea element ($textarea) rather than the container ($module).",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/govuk/components/character-count/character-count.js",
      "sha256": "b17688138faafe0e8e1b3b435f890c52c8dc6ca9fbcbb8644f2e93a5125f7b90",
      "before": "  // Save the element limit\n  this.maxLength = $module.getAttribute(countAttribute)\n\n  // Check for limit\n  if (!this.maxLength) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  // Remove hard limit if set\n  $module.removeAttribute('maxlength')\n\n  this.bindChangeEvents()",
    "after": "  // Save the element limit\n  this.maxLength = $module.getAttribute(countAttribute)\n\n  // Check for limit\n  if (!this.maxLength) {\n    return\n  }\n\n  // Remove hard limit if set\n  $textarea.removeAttribute('maxlength')\n\n  this.bindChangeEvents()"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Users can enter more than 30 characters and the visible and screen‑reader character count will accurately report when the limit is exceeded, providing correct feedback.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Removing the maxlength attribute from the textarea could theoretically affect code that relies on that attribute being present on the container, but no such usage exists in the current codebase.",
    "Ensuring the removal does not interfere with the noscript fallback, which relies on the maxlength attribute remaining on the textarea when JavaScript is disabled."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Type 34 characters into the summary field and verify the full value is retained.",
    "Verify the visible count message reads \"You have 4 characters too many\".",
    "Verify the screen‑reader live region is updated with the same message.",
    "Confirm the maxlength attribute is absent from the textarea after the CharacterCount init runs.",
    "Confirm that with JavaScript disabled the textarea still enforces the 30‑character limit via the maxlength attribute."
  ]
}
